name: ememdemo
description: Turn any file into a link your AI agent can read. A static page over emem.dev; these skills run at emem.dev's A2A endpoint.

skills.name: store a link
skills.description: Store text as a signed note named by the hash of its bytes.

skills.name: read a link by name
skills.description: Read a note by its file name (the hash of its bytes), with its author's signature.

skills.name: check an answer
skills.description: Resolve every emem: citation in a text and return a signed allow or deny with a reason code.

skills.name: ask about a place
skills.description: A signed answer about a real place, with the facts it used.

skills.name: resolve emem:fact
skills.description: one signed measurement at a place

skills.name: resolve emem:cell
skills.description: a place on Earth, about 10 m across

skills.name: resolve emem:entity
skills.description: one shared identity for a real thing

skills.name: resolve emem:raster
skills.description: a field of pixels over an area

skills.name: resolve emem:cube
skills.description: the same field across several dates
